categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Shijing Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial pollution control equipment manufacturing and photovoltaic (PV) product manufacturing. Its main business segments include process pollution prevention equipment, terminal pollution control equipment, remote online monitoring systems, operation and maintenance services, third-party testing services, and photovoltaic products such as high-efficiency solar cells. The company also engages in environmental protection engineering, system design, manufacturing, installation, and after-sales services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as low-temperature liquid catalytic denitrification (LCR) technology, integrated desulfurization and denitrification, pollution synergistic treatment, special gas hazardous gas treatment, dust explosion prevention systems, and VOCs resin adsorption and catalytic combustion. In photovoltaic production, it employs advanced automated production lines for TOPCon solar cells with industry-leading conversion efficiencies above 26.5%. The manufacturing process integrates waste gas, wastewater, and ultrapure water treatment to reduce costs and environmental impact.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily in the photovoltaic industry, semiconductor, fine chemical, automotive manufacturing, steel metallurgy, and cement building materials sectors. The company serves leading global photovoltaic cell and module manufacturers, including top five global PV cell and top ten PV module producers. Its products and services cater to industrial pollution control needs in these sectors, focusing on process pollution prevention and terminal pollution treatment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with domestic business accounting for approximately 89.8% of revenue. It has also expanded its international presence, with overseas business contributing about 10.2% of revenue and showing growth. Key operational bases include Suzhou, Anhui (Ningguo), and other locations in China, with subsidiaries and investments across multiple provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Shijing Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection and photovoltaic supply chains. It manufactures specialized pollution control equipment and photovoltaic cells, providing integrated solutions and services to industrial customers. The company also extends its value chain through engineering, installation, operation, and maintenance services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes dual growth engines: photovoltaic supporting equipment and photovoltaic product manufacturing, aligned with China's 'dual carbon' goals. R&D focuses on advanced pollution control technologies, high-efficiency solar cell development (TOPCon technology), carbon capture and utilization (CCUS), and integrated waste gas and wastewater treatment. It invests in digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and new materials, aiming to enhance product performance, reduce costs, and expand into new markets such as cement and steel industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of customized industrial pollution control equipment, photovoltaic products, and related engineering services. The company uses project-based procurement and production, with sales realized via bidding and business negotiations. Additional revenue streams include operation and maintenance services, third-party testing, and material sales. Government subsidies and investment income also contribute to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in the photovoltaic industry’s pollution control equipment segment and is recognized as a key industrial pollution control solutions provider in China. It competes with specialized pollution control equipment manufacturers and photovoltaic cell producers, leveraging its proprietary technologies and integrated service capabilities. Its strong R&D and multi-industry application experience provide competitive advantages against peers in environmental protection and PV sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.05 billion, a 40.34% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to reduced sales in process pollution control equipment and low PV product prices. Net profit attributable to shareholders was a loss of RMB 771 million, reversing from profit in 2023. Total assets grew by 35% to RMB 10.48 billion, reflecting investments in new production lines and subsidiaries. The company is in a capacity ramp-up phase for its PV cell production, expecting improved scale efficiencies in 2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou Shijing Technology differentiates itself through advanced proprietary pollution control technologies that achieve high efficiency and low emissions with integrated solutions. Its TOPCon solar cells feature industry-leading conversion efficiencies and cost advantages due to integrated environmental treatment processes. The company offers customized, one-stop industrial pollution prevention and control solutions with strong multi-industry applicability, supported by extensive project experience and a comprehensive service chain from design to operation. Its commitment to innovation and alignment with national carbon reduction policies enhance its competitive positioning.
